text:
matt.price: Cutting RC from main at commit abc1234 for feature/ops-improvements. Target cut & promo window 2026-03-21 09:00-10:00 PT. Cut ticket: INFR-512. RC tag will be rc-1977. Need infra pin, QA smoke, security check, and sheriff ack. Any objections?
anya.k: LGTM from product. Release notes draft: https://docs.internal/redwood/releases/rc-1977 - added known limitations and rollout notes. :white_check_mark:
linh: Perf baseline: a single perf test is flaky under heavy tail, but not blocking. I'll run a quick local load and KV-cache sanity post-cut.
deploy-bot: preflight summary for rc-1977: build=success, image pushed to registry.redwood.io/redwood/serving:rc-1977, unit_tests=312/312 passed, integ_smoke_skipped=false. Canaries configured: 10%->50%->100% with auto-fallback.
oliver.qa: QA smoke slot booked 09:05 PT. I'll run the minimal smoke checklist: login, simple generation, streaming, basic latency. Will report pass/fail here.
sam.infra: Reserving dedicated pool: pool-redwood-ded-3. Autoscaler min=5 max=50, burst enabled. I'll pin the image and create the rollout plan. Pin command I will use: ```kubectl set image deploy/inference api=registry.redwood.io/redwood/serving:rc-1977 -n prod```
rina.sec: KMS and secrets check done. Vault mount OK, no new privileges. Confirming no PII in logs for this cut.
release-sheriff: I'll own the window. Proposed canary cadence: 10% for 15m, check telemetry snapshot at +10m, 50% for 30m, then 100% if stable. Rollback triggers: error rate >1% sustained for 5m OR p95 latency >800ms for 10m. Require infra/qa/sec sign-off before promoting to 100%.
matt.price: tagging infra/qa/sec/sheriff: @sam.infra @oliver.qa @rina.sec @release-sheriff - can you confirm?
sam.infra: signed. Pinned image and pre-created k8s rollout manifest in infra/rollouts/rc-1977.yaml :thumbsup:
oliver.qa: smoke started at 09:05 PT. Running flows. Quick note: test user data uses staging tokens.
oliver.qa: smoke passed at 09:12 PT. Gen, streaming, and auth flows look good. No obvious regressions. Latency p95 ~210ms on tests.
rina.sec: security sign-off at 09:15 PT. No vuln regressed in the scan.
deploy-bot: canary kickoff: rc-1977 -> starting canary at 09:20 PT, routing 10% traffic. Canary job id: deploy-1977-ck1. Logs: tail -f /var/log/deploys/deploy-1977.log
matt.price: watching dashboards: https://datadog.redwood/boards/rc-1977-metrics. Alert thresholds set per sheriff plan.
deploy-bot: canary health @ +10m: errors 0.08%, p95 latency 220ms, token cost within expected. No alerts.
linh: verified KV cache hit-rate steady, batching latency within expected envelope. Good to move to 50%.
release-sheriff: moving to 50% now. Keep eyes on traces and tail error logs.
deploy-bot: routing moved to 50% at 09:38 PT. Canary job id: deploy-1977-ck2.
matt.price: all clear from my side.
deploy-bot: canary stable after 30m window. Metrics: errors 0.05%, p95 230ms, CPU/GPU within expected headroom. Proceeding to promote to 100% and pin.
deploy-bot: promote command run: `redwoodctl rollout promote --tag rc-1977 --pin --release-note "rc-1977 feature/ops-improvements"`
deploy-bot: promotion complete at 09:59 PT. All routes now on rc-1977. Monitoring for automatic rollback according to thresholds for next 60m.
release-sheriff: marking RC as promoted. Noted rollback thresholds in ticket INFR-512. Good job team. :tada:
anya.k: Updated release notes and sent announcement to #product-updates. Will follow up with customers impacted by breaking change #23.
matt.price: thanks everyone. Closing the cut ticket after 24h stability window if no regression.
